name: llava-bench-coco
description: llava-bench-coco evaluates multimodal models (notably LLaVA-style instruction-tuned vision-language models) on COCO-derived image understanding tasks such as image captioning and visual question answering using instruction-style prompts. It measures the models' ability to produce fluent, relevant captions and answer visual questions aligned with COCO references. The benchmark is used to assess multimodal instruction-following and open-ended image generation/description performance.
reputation: A community-contributed COCO-based evaluation set used for quick comparison of instruction-tuned multimodal models; moderately used in experiments but not an official COCO split.
